crash.title: {app} stopped working
crash.body: Nexus kept running. You can restart the app; unsaved changes in this window may be lost.

storage.localstorageBody: IndexedDB isn't available here, so Nexus uses localStorage (about 5 MB). Export a backup regularly.
storage.memoryBody: This browser blocks storage (private mode or blocked site data). Everything disappears when you close the tab.
storage.quotaBody: The last change couldn't be saved. Free space in Settings → Storage: empty the trash or remove large files.
storage.evictionHint: Your browser may delete Nexus data that isn't used for a while. Install Nexus as an app and export backups to keep it safe.

migration.failedBody: Your data is safe and read-only until this is fixed. Details are in the system log.
migration.newerTitle: {app} has data from a newer Nexus
migration.newerBody: It opens read-only. Reload the page to get the newest version of Nexus.

scheduler.limits: Reminders and alarms only ring while Nexus is open in a browser tab. A closed tab can't ring.

dialog.unavailable: This dialog arrives with the desktop in a later version.
